title: Wanderlane Traveller Club Standing on Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
Holding an active Wanderlane Traveller Club membership changes what a booking under Air Ticket Fare Brands is charged, and the fare brand's own rates apply to everything the club does not cover.

**What the club standing decided.** The club tier held on the day the ticket is issued was formerly the basis deciding whether the agency booking service fee was waived and whether the first checked bag was carried free. That basis is no longer in force.

**How a waiver appears on the booking.** Where the club waives a charge, the line is not raised at all rather than raised and then refunded, so a waived fee never appears on the booking.

**Standing alongside a brand inclusion.** A club benefit and a fare-brand inclusion were formerly held never to stack into a payment to the traveller, a bag already included in the brand held being simply free and the club benefit not converted into value. That basis is no longer in force.

**A membership that lapses.** A membership that lapses between booking and ticketing carries no benefit, because the tier held at ticketing is the one that counts.

**Points.** Club points accrue on the base fare alone, at the club points earn rate of the fare brand held, and never on taxes, on carrier fees, on the agency booking service fee or on optional extras. Tier-qualifying points are counted separately from spendable points, at the tier-qualifying multiplier of the brand held. A booking paid for entirely with a travel credit earns neither kind of point.
